card.intuition: Business logic focuses on core rules driving application behavior, separate from infrastructure concerns.
card.analogy: Business logic is the engine of your application — like a car transmission, it takes input and delivers output without the driver needing internal details.
when_to_use: When implementing business rules in a new feature
During code reviews to ensure separation of concerns
When designing new modules to avoid circular dependencies
gotchas: Mixing business logic with database queries makes testing difficult
Changing business rules often requires cascading updates across the codebase
